description: Ministry of Ports Shipping and Aviation - Carriage by Air (Amendment) Act, No 8 of 2023
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - specifically an amendment to the Carriage by Air Act (No. 8 of 2023) and the specification of liability limits under that legislation. While it mentions Minister Nimal Siripala De Silva, this is only in the context of exercising statutory powers under the Act, not as a personnel appointment or detailed portfolio assignment. The core content is about establishing legal liability limits for air carriage, which falls squarely under legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel or structural changes.
